tagline: Global attractions and hospitality company operating iconic travel experiences
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI reflects the company's overall performance in generating revenue from its 17 attractions and 29 lodges in major tourist destinations.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from attractions, lodges, food and beverage, retail, and transportation.
kpis.description: Represents the total income from attraction operations, lodges, food and beverage, retail, and transportation across operating geographic regions.
kpis.signal: Primary revenue indicator reflecting demand for attraction and hospitality experiences.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold and services provided.
kpis.description: Measures the company's efficiency in producing or acquiring the goods and services it sells to customers.
kpis.signal: Indicates the direct profitability of services and experiences offered to visitors.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in acquiring or upgrading long-term assets to support growth.
kpis.description: Includes spending on new attractions, hotel renovations, facility improvements, and other fixed assets.
kpis.signal: Reflects investments in expanding and enhancing attractions and lodges.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company across all operations.
kpis.description: The total headcount, including seasonal and full-time staff, operating in attractions and lodges.
kpis.signal: Indicator of operational scale and labor cost structure.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has not provided specific information regarding its position or strategies related to artificial intelligence in the excerpts provided.
